key_insight: Syn4D is a multiview synthetic 4D dataset that provides dense, complete, and accurate ground-truth geometry and tracking (camera motion, per-frame depth, dense pixel tracking, and parametric human poses) for dynamic scenes, enabling reliable development and benchmarking of monocular 3D reconstruction and tracking methods.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of high-quality datasets with dense and accurate geometric annotations for dynamic scenes, which has limited progress in dense 3D reconstruction and tracking from monocular video.
method: Create diverse synthetic dynamic scenes and render synchronized multiview video sequences with controlled variations (motion, lighting, occlusion).
Record precise ground-truth annotations: camera trajectories, per-frame depth maps, dense per-pixel correspondences (tracking), and parametric human pose parameters.
Package standardized splits, evaluation metrics and example baselines to enable consistent benchmarking and supervised training.
impact: Provides a reliable, noise-free benchmark and training resource that lets researchers train and evaluate geometry and tracking algorithms more effectively, accelerating progress in monocular 3D reconstruction, dynamic scene understanding, and related downstream tasks.
visual_elements: Triplet visualization: RGB frame • ground-truth depth map • dense tracking flow side-by-side for the same timestep
3D scene overview showing reconstructed geometry with overlaid ground-truth camera trajectories
Annotated human skeletons (parametric poses) overlaid on frames with corresponding 3D pose visualization
Benchmark chart comparing reconstruction/tracking metrics across methods on Syn4D (precision/recall, depth RMSE, tracking accuracy)
paper_authors: Zeren Jiang, Yushi Lan, Yihang Luo, Yufan Deng, Zihang Lai
